divergence_justification: Judge accept, gap_shaped paired residual: MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.validityPeriod.start and .end are absent for invalid, reversed, or incomplete prescription intervals because mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_medication_request.sql:172-177 emits the period only for complete non-reversed intervals; no FHIR path retains rejected endpoints and authoredOn is pharmacy entry time, not a substitute. Direct and medication-mix ingredient branches, UNION ALL multiplicity, exact validity paths, and TRY_CAST(... AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) were exhausted; no resource-id inversion is used. All 112014 rows and multiplicity are retained, with 9059 paired differing_null_only rows (candidate NULL starttime on 9058 and stoptime on 9051), zero conflicts/unpaired rows, and 102955/112014 identical. The missing endpoints are ancillary because acei.sql performs no temporal filtering, grouping, carry-forward, or clinical derivation.

reopen_history.reason: Type B cast defect: TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(REGEXP_REPLACE(col, offset-strip), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss[.SSSSSS]") returns NULL on any shape the pinned format misses (date-only values especially), and TRY_ makes it silent -- those NULLs reach the judge as differing_null_only/gap_shaped, i.e. a parse failure disguised as a FHIR coverage gap at the lower bar. Replace every datetime mapping with a bare TRY_CAST(col AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ). See pathling-sql SKILL.md and MIMIC_NOTES.md:337.
